note: Social Auth Google is a Google OAuth2 provider for the Social Auth framework. Its settings live in config object social_auth_google.settings (client_id, client_secret, scopes, endpoints, restricted_domain); Network plugin id social_auth_google; service social_auth_google.manager. Actually logging in requires real Google OAuth credentials + Google's servers (external), so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the LOCAL config object only, verifiable via drush php:eval: introspection reads back the stored client_id/restricted_domain and the configured scopes; execution sets the client id/secret and the restricted domain. Baseline: all keys empty; cleanup restores empty strings.

evals.prompt: Where do I enter the Google OAuth Client ID and Client Secret for the social_auth_google module? Name the config object and the admin path.
evals.expected_output: On the settings form at /admin/config/social-api/social-auth/google (route social_auth_google.settings_form), stored in config object social_auth_google.settings under client_id and client_secret.

evals.prompt: What framework/module does social_auth_google build on, and what is the id of the Network plugin it provides?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the Social Auth (social_auth) framework and provides a Network plugin with id social_auth_google (social network 'Google'); base social_auth handles the login routes and account creation.

evals.prompt: Which OAuth scopes does social_auth_google always request, and what does its restricted_domain setting do?
evals.expected_output: The scopes openid, email and profile are always requested (extra scopes are comma-separated). restricted_domain limits sign-in to a single Google Workspace domain (empty = any Google account).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the social_auth_google configuration and tell me the configured Google OAuth Client ID and the restricted domain (if any).
evals.expected_output: config social_auth_google.settings has client_id = 'eval-123.apps.googleusercontent.com' and restricted_domain = 'example.com'.

evals.prompt: Inspect the social_auth_google configuration on this site and tell me which additional OAuth scope has been configured (beyond the default openid/email/profile).
evals.expected_output: The scopes key in social_auth_google.settings is set to https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly (requested in addition to the always-on openid/email/profile).

evals.prompt: Configure the social_auth_google module with the Google OAuth Client ID 'eval-set.apps.googleusercontent.com' and Client Secret 'eval-secret-xyz'. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: In config social_auth_google.settings set client_id = 'eval-set.apps.googleusercontent.com' and client_secret = 'eval-secret-xyz' and save (e.g. drush config:set social_auth_google.settings client_id ... / client_secret ...).

evals.prompt: Restrict Google sign-in on this site so only accounts from the Google Workspace domain 'acme.example' can log in via social_auth_google. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In config social_auth_google.settings set restricted_domain = 'acme.example' and save. verify checks restricted_domain === 'acme.example'.
